title: fix: UC write routing — promote path to saveAsTable for Unity Catalog…
body:
… connections

When SparkEngine.write() receives path= (not table=) with a Unity Catalog connection, get_path() resolves it to a dotted table name like 'workspace.sim_demo.my_table'. Previously this went through .save() which treats it as a relative filesystem path, causing:

  IllegalArgumentException: Path must be absolute:
  workspace.sim_demo.sample_output/_delta_log

Now the engine detects UC connections before the table/path branch and promotes dotted names to saveAsTable(). Volume paths (starting with /) are correctly left as file-based writes.

Includes 8 new tests covering all routing scenarios. Bumps version to 3.13.7.
